sloka: तेन पादतलाक्रान्ता रम्येषु गिरिसानुषु ।सघोषाः समशीर्यन्त शिलाश्चूर्णीकृतास्ततः ।। 5.56.22 ।।।।
transliteration: tena pādatalākrāntā ramyeṣu girisānuṣu ।saghoṣāḥ samaśīryanta śilāścūrṇīkṛtāstataḥ ।। 5.56.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Crushed under Hanuman's feet the rocks making a loud noise on the beautiful mountain ranges rolled down, reduced to powder.
